correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs all primitive-two firing patterns from Laplacian conservation, derives necessary and sufficient independent chip intervals, counts each state exactly once, then proves an exact trace identity and triangular eigenvalue formula. For all min(a,b)→infinity, Gaussian dominated Riemann sums prove the joint asymptotic. Standalone brute-force updater checked 729,348 states and exact arithmetic 121 size pairs; finite checks supplement the all-parameter proof.

originality.rationale: Exact primitive two-cycle orbit totals and their trace/eigenvalue reduction are not supplied by inspected known period-possibility and middle-stair theorems. The latter imply existence/eventual period in certain intervals, not an all-mass orbit census. Bitar–Goles (1992) and Jung (2026) full texts were not obtainable, so unindexed prior equivalence remains a stated risk, not a novelty guarantee.
residual_risks: The 1992 Bitar–Goles and 2026 Jung full texts were not available; an already published equivalent orbit enumeration there cannot be excluded.
The general symmetric-binomial transition-kernel spectrum may be classical in probability; the new claim is its specific exact interpretation as chip-firing two-cycle orbit census and asymptotic.
Semantic record search is not exhaustive for unindexed papers or different terminology.

value.rationale: The all-parameter population of genuine period-two attractor orbits is a natural but previously unevaluated invariant beyond which periods can occur. The exact sum unexpectedly collapses a two-dimensional configuration count to a min(a,b)+1-term spectral trace, and its universal √(ab/(a+b)) prefactor resolves precise scale/rareness even at highly unbalanced shore growth; not an arbitrary finite slice, renaming, or mere period-existence corollary.
